nomiss.enabled.tooltip: Protect selected items from wasted attacks. Applies immediately.
nomiss.cooldown.tooltip: Only attack an entity when the attack strength is fully recharged. Does not queue or automatically repeat attacks.
nomiss.blocks.tooltip: Let selected items hit and break blocks normally. Turn off to require an entity target.
nomiss.limit: All %s slots are full. Clear a slot before adding another selection.
nomiss.save_failed: Couldn't save NoMiss settings. Check the game log.
nomiss.picker.hint: Choose a category or an individual item. Categories use one slot.
nomiss.already_selected: Already selected as weapon %s. Clear that slot to move it.
nomiss.status.tooltip: Show NoMiss ON/OFF and the active profile. Its position, size and opacity are configured below. Independent of other indicators; hidden with F1.
nomiss.hints.tooltip: Briefly show why a click was blocked: out of reach, cooldown, or block breaking disabled. Does not change attack protection.
nomiss.blocked.reach: NoMiss: Out of reach / no entity targeted
nomiss.reset.tooltip: Restore only this setting to its default. Your item selections and other options stay as they are.
nomiss.add_held.tooltip: Add your main-hand item to the first empty weapon slot. Existing selections are never replaced.
nomiss.add_held.no_world: Join a world to add your held item.
nomiss.add_held.empty: Hold an item in your main hand first.
nomiss.keybinds.tooltip: Change NoMiss shortcuts in Minecraft’s Key Binds menu, under NoMiss. New shortcuts are unbound by default.
nomiss.selection.duplicate: This selection is already in another slot in this profile.
nomiss.profile.defaults_hint: Cooldown and block options are this profile’s defaults.
nomiss.priority_hint: Priority: exact item → item type → category.
nomiss.profile.use: Switch to %s. Server assignment is updated when automatic profiles are on.
nomiss.profile.delete.confirm: Delete “%s” and its server assignments? Other profiles are kept.
nomiss.preset.hint: All presets start with cooldown protection OFF. PvP disables block breaking.
nomiss.auto_server.tooltip: Remember your selected profile for each multiplayer server and load it on joining. Restore your previous manual profile on leaving. Server addresses stay local and are excluded from exports.
nomiss.server.remember: Remember active profile for this server
nomiss.server.unavailable: Join a multiplayer server to manage its assignment.
nomiss.export.done: Settings copied. Server addresses were excluded.
nomiss.import.invalid: Clipboard does not contain valid, supported NoMiss settings.
nomiss.import.confirm: Import %s profiles and replace ALL current profiles and HUD settings? Server assignments will be cleared and automatic server profiles disabled. Your current settings will be backed up first.
nomiss.import.done: Settings imported. Your previous configuration was backed up.
nomiss.import.failed: Could not preserve or save settings. The import was cancelled.
nomiss.exact.tooltip: Match this item’s name, enchantments and other properties, ignoring stack count, durability and repair cost. Identical copies match. Renaming or changing properties requires selecting it again.
nomiss.exact.label: Exact: %s
nomiss.exact.failed: Hold an item in a world first. Its properties must be serializable.
nomiss.rule.reset: Reset both rules to profile defaults
nomiss.rule.inherit_hint: Profile default follows General; ON/OFF overrides only this slot.
nomiss.clear.confirm: Clear all 20 selections in this profile? Other profiles are kept.
nomiss.protected.tooltip: Show whether your main-hand item is currently protected. Independent of the status and blocked-attack indicators.
